card.band: 8 h. The C build and msgpack manipulation take most of the time. A frontier agent gets set/remove on nested keys but misses array indices, key-creation rules and condition parity. A weaker model fails to compile or crashes. Buckets by operation and condition.
card.cheat: No shortcut through a test-only path: the tests use the real engine and random records. The snapshot has no git history and no later upstream copy.
card.grading: Hidden runtime tests that drive the engine with in-memory inputs through an lib-output callback, comparing the msgpack/JSON output for generated configs and records. The existing runtime filter tests are the regression gate. Exact output match, no fuzz tolerance.
card.reference: Our own reference patch, expected 900-1400 changed lines of C across the filter, record-accessor and test code. It is written by us, because upstream never implemented the issue as asked.
card.task: /app ships a snapshot of Fluent Bit at the pinned commit. The agent adds record-accessor keys ($a['b'][0]) to the modify filter for Set, Add, Rename, Copy, Remove, Hard_rename and all Condition types. It also adds regex and wildcard key sets, nested-path creation and array indexing, with the config schema and docs updated.
card.title: Record accessor support across Fluent Bit modify filter and conditions

history: Feature method: base builds in about 5 min total with bundled deps (build ran with network on; offline not separately tested, no downloads were seen). 36 filter_modify runtime tests pass identically 3 times. Needs -DFLB_USE_SIMDUTF=No on gcc 12 and flex/bison installed. Probes: nested Key_value_equa

spike.headroom_note: Feature idea: base lacks rule record-accessor support (Set $a['b'] creates a literal key; Remove is a no-op; Key_exists with [0] does not hit). No upstream implementation checked beyond the issue being open.
spike.notes: Feature method: base builds in about 5 min total with bundled deps (build ran with network on; offline not separately tested, no downloads were seen). 36 filter_modify runtime tests pass identically 3 times. Needs -DFLB_USE_SIMDUTF=No on gcc 12 and flex/bison installed. Probes: nested Key_value_equals works; array index [0] in Key_exists does not; Set with $a['b'] creates a literal key; Remove with RA is a no-op. I did not check whether the record accessor library can index arrays or create paths, or whether any PR or later release implements the feature. The reference size of 1000 lines is an estimate.

facts.claim: Fluent Bit issue #4651 exists, is open, was opened 2022-01-21, and asks for modify-filter Copy/Remove to match record-accessor nested keys
Issue #4651 lists no linked or closing pull request (Development section: 'No branches or pull requests')
Maintainer said the modify filter does not support record accessors yet; only STRING:KEY in Conditions accepts them
Repository licence is Apache License 2.0 at the pinned commit f4739648
Pinned commit f4739648 is fetchable and contains plugins/filter_modify/modify.c

At the pinned commit, modify.c calls flb_ra_create only for condition keys (Key_exists, Key_does_not_exist, Key_value_equals, Key_value_does_not_equal, Key_value_matches, Key_value_does_not_match); no rule type (Set, Add, Rename, Copy, Remove, Hard_rename) uses record accessor
Official modify filter docs say Conditions accept nested keys as STRING:KEY via record accessor; they give no $a['b'][0] syntax reference and no version
Public upstream has no implementation of record-accessor keys in modify rules (Set/Add/Rename/Copy/Remove/Hard_rename) in any release or open PR
Test count (4492 test files) and reference size (900-1400 changed lines) were verified

spike_plan.kill_if: Build needs network downloads, baseline runtime tests flake across runs, or the record accessor library cannot index arrays, meaning the scope needs new library work and must be re-scoped.
spike_plan.pass_if: Build finishes in under 30 min offline, baseline runtime tests are green and identical across three runs, and at least one nested condition probe resolves as expected.
steps: In a networked throwaway Linux container, clone fluent-bit at f4739648 and cmake-configure with runtime tests on; time the build with -j8.
Confirm the build works offline with bundled deps (retry with network off for the second build).
Run the existing filter_modify runtime tests three times and record per-test results to check determinism.
Write four probe configs: Condition Key_exists with $a['b'][0], Set with $a['b'], Remove with $a['b'], and Key_value_equals on a nested key.
Run each probe through the lib output and record the msgpack/JSON result to see which paths are currently no-ops.
Check whether the record accessor library resolves array indexes like [0] and creates nothing on Set, to size the array and creation work.

v1.summary: The seed is real and sized right: issue #4651 is open with no linked PR, the repo is Apache-2.0, and at the pinned commit only conditions use record accessors while rule keys are exact-string matches. It passes with conditions: the task must pin nested-creation and array-index semantics in the spec (otherwise exact-match hidden tests encode reference choices), and the smoke build was empty so the build and spike are unverified.

v2.note: Real open issue #4651 with no upstream PR; maintainer confirmed that rules lack record-accessor support. Seals well because no public implementation exists. The reference is unwritten and its size (900-1400 lines) is unverified. Main risk: semantics for nested-path creation, array indexing and regex/wildcard keys on accessor paths are underspecified. Exact-match tests would encode our own choices and reject reasonable alternatives, so the spec must pin each behaviour with visible examples. frontier_hours of 8 on an 8 h tier is tight but acceptable. Build is unverified because the smoke build is empty.
